sql: SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(cast("from" AS VARCHAR),'^\+1[0-9]{10}$')) from_valid_before,count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(cast("to" AS VARCHAR),'^\+1[0-9]{10}$')) to_valid_before,count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(cast("from" AS VARCHAR),'[^0-9]','','g'),'^1?([0-9]{10})$','+1\1'),'^\+1[0-9]{10}$')) from_valid_after,count(*) FILTER(WHERE regexp_full_match(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(cast("to" AS VARCHAR),'[^0-9]','','g'),'^1?([0-9]{10})$','+1\1'),'^\+1[0-9]{10}$')) to_valid_after FROM raw.call_data
